title: Blitz (2022) — 논문 원본 Quant Cycle 정의로 한국시장 복제

design.paper: Blitz (2022) The Quant Cycle, Robeco/Journal of Portfolio Management
design.IMPORTANT: 논문 원본 정의. 매크로 타이밍 한계 인정 → 팩터 자체 시그널 기반.

paper_factor_definitions.Value: Composite: BM + Earnings Yield (E/P) + CF Yield (CF/P). 3개 평균 z-score.
paper_factor_definitions.Quality: Composite: ROE + Debt/Equity(-) + Earnings Stability. 3개 평균 z-score.

paper_quant_cycle_signals.factor_valuation: 각 팩터의 value spread = top quintile 평균 BM - bottom quintile 평균 BM. spread 넓으면 cheap → overweight. expanding window로 z-score 변환.
paper_quant_cycle_signals.factor_momentum: 각 팩터의 trailing 12m long-short return. 양이면 → overweight.
paper_quant_cycle_signals.combined_signal: factor_valuation_z + factor_momentum_z. 둘 다 양이면 strong overweight.
paper_quant_cycle_signals.allocation: signal 비례 가중. min 10%, max 40%. signal 전부 음수면 EW.
